title: Trap Tag Placement - Room Traps
body:
Syntax: TRAP PLACE <type>  |  TRAP TAG PLACEMENT <type>

Bukijutsu automatically learns Trap Tag Placement at ninja level 10. Other classes may READ its teaching scroll at ninja level 25 (object VNUM 31761 in the reserved scroll area 31501-32000). The scroll is not automatically sold; builders may stock it. As with other skills, Bukijutsu users must practice the technique with a teacher at least once; a scroll taught technique gets its usual one-time teacher introduction bypass.

Set a trap in your current PvP-enabled room, consuming one matching physical inventory item (the named tag or an existing Exploding Note, Smoke Bomb, Poison Gas Bomb, or Exploding Clay). Use 'trap place' for a usage list. Basic Explosive Trap and Wire Snare tags require level 10; other tags have separate item-level requirements. Each placement spends 15 base Chakra, 10 base Stamina (normal level-based jutsu scaling applies), and has a 10-second cooldown. Limits: three active tags per room, one owned by each player per room, six active tags per player; tags expire after 30 minutes, are single-use, and persist across reboot in a separate /data ledger. No tags may be placed in safe, apartment, or player-shop rooms. Any non-immortal player entering the room triggers an enemy trap, even without PvP organization membership. The trap owner and members of the owner's PvP organization do not trigger damaging or disabling tags; immortal staff remain immune. Alarm Seal Tags are different: they activate for any non-owner, non-immortal entrant, even allied or PvP-opted-out players, and notify the owner if online. Immortals can see active hidden tags, owner names and remaining lifetime in LOOK. Ordinary players cannot see hidden tags.

On entering the room, players with Trap Disabling already learned AUTOMATICALLY attempt to remove the tag before its effect activates: success chance ranges from 25% at zero proficiency to 90% at 100% mastery; on failure, the tag springs normally. No manual command or extra Chakra is required to attempt this automatic disarm.

Tag effects: explosive blasts, wire snares entangle, flashbangs blind, paralysis tags paralyze, drain tags remove Chakra and apply Drained, fire tags burn, alarm tags notify their online owner, suppression tags silence, and barrier disruption tags remove normal active barriers. Existing traps can also be placed as room versions using 'note', 'smoke', 'gas', or 'clay'. The old Kage 'trap buy' territory defense remains separate and unchanged.

Shop: mob VNUM 785 sells every trap tag object VNUM 80-88, plus the four existing Exploding Note / Smoke Bomb / Poison Gas Bomb / Exploding Clay consumables (9803-9806) for room placement. Traps persist in data/room_trap_tags.json across restarts until triggered, disarmed or expired (30 minutes). The shop also stocks a poison-only Antidote Pill (VNUM 89).
